copy.introText: Build confidence with maths and computing ideas behind AI, one question at a time.
copy.learningNoteTitle: Why maths and computing for AI?
copy.learningNote: Explore how maths, patterns and clear instructions help people understand the ideas behind AI.

copy.homeConfirm: Go back to the home screen? Your current quiz answers, score and streak will be lost.
copy.streakDescription: A streak is your number of correct answers in a row. It celebrates steady learning; a mistake is just a fresh start.
copy.streakHelp: A streak counts correct answers in a row. Keep learning; one mistake is never the end of the game.

copy.leaderboardNotReady: Enter your nickname and your teacher's class code to join the board.
copy.leaderboardSaved: Your best score is on the class leaderboard!
copy.leaderboardUpdated: Your class leaderboard is up to date.

copy.classCodeInvalid: Ask your teacher for a class code with {min}–{max} letters, numbers or hyphens.
